items.summary: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
items.recommend_reason_zh: alibaba/open-code-review 结合确定性流水线与LLM Agent，输出精确到行的审查评论，内置NPE、XSS、SQL注入等规则，值得打开体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: alibaba/open-code-review is a hybrid code review tool combining deterministic pipelines with an LLM agent for precise line-level comments, a built-in multi-language ruleset covering NPE, thread-safety, XSS and SQL injection, and OpenAI/Anthropic compatibility, worth opening to explore its Alibaba-scale design.
